maddeler.e:
انتجبوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَجَبُوا (intajabū) /in.ta.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# اُنْتُجِبُوا (untujibū) /un.tu.d͡ʒi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# اِنْتَجِبُوا (intajibū) /in.ta.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
